context.user-input: regency runs on Claude Code only; the Regent wants other models and their harnesses to work under the same rules

intention.user-input: one source of regency, one generated target per harness, so a rule is written once and every harness reads the same rule

problem.user-input: the doctrine, the playbooks and the scripts are portable, and the surface around them is Claude Code's: the plugin manifest, skill frontmatter, command aliases, the hooks wire, the question pop-up, role subagents with model names, the auto-mode profile, the headless runner and CLAUDE.md

deny.user-input: parallel copies drift and every fix is picked once per branch; plumbing, testing and main already mean maturity

never.user-input: a branch per harness, or a second hand-kept copy of any playbook, script or norm

constraint.user-input: every target file is generated from library/registry.json and library/targets.json by scripts/build.py and is never edited by hand
the Claude Code target stays byte-identical at every commit: build.py --check up to date and doctor 0 fail
regency code stays Python, standard library only; nothing is vendored
a format enters only with a consumer that parses it and a self-test that plants a defect per rule

mandatory.user-input: each fact about another harness is read from that harness's current documentation and cited with its date in library/targets.md; none comes from a model's memory

never.user-input: a credential of any harness is read, stored or guarded; logins are the Regent's

mandatory.user-input: small split commits on plumbing, then testing, then main; the Regent pushes main

limitation.user-input: a harness without tool-call hooks cannot be guarded at the moment of the call; there a guard is a git hook, a CI check or only a written rule, and the target says which
how well a smaller model follows a long playbook is outside regency's reach; the answer is to move rules from prose into scripts, never to fork the playbook
adopting Claude Code plugins as packs stays a Claude Code feature in this Order
a harness without subagents runs the roles one after another in fresh contexts, or declares the team pass unsupported

target.user-input: library/targets.md: one row per harness-specific surface of regency, classed portable, generated, adapter or unsupported

instruction.user-input: list every file and script that names Claude Code, a Claude model, a Claude Code tool or a path under the user's .claude folder; read the current documentation of each candidate harness for its entry file, command format, hook events, subagents, question tool and headless mode

mandatory.user-input: a capability matrix, harness by surface, each cell with its source and date

ready.user-input: every hit of a search for claude, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, AskUserQuestion, Opus, Sonnet and Haiku across skills, library, scripts and hooks is in the table or marked portable

target.user-input: library/targets.json as the single source of every target: id, entry file, command format, hook support, role tiers, status; claude-code is the first row and describes what exists today

instruction.user-input: build.py loads the table and refuses an unknown key; conventions_check.py validates it; doctor runs both

ready.user-input: build.py --check is up to date with the table present and the generated Claude Code files unchanged

target.user-input: AGENTS.md, and one entry file per target that needs its own name, generated from the same source text as CLAUDE.md: start here, the command table with playbook paths, the map, the rules

instruction.user-input: move the hand-written parts of CLAUDE.md into one source that build.py renders per target; each entry file names its harness only where the harness differs

ready.user-input: a fresh session of a second harness, given only the repository, opens its entry file, finds a playbook by the table and runs doctor

target.user-input: the team, the speed modes and the role agents name tiers, lead, builder and drafter, instead of model names; targets.json maps each tier to a model per target

instruction.user-input: replace model names in library/team/SPEED_MODES.md, skills/team/SKILL.md and library/agents; install-agents.py reads the claude-code mapping

ready.user-input: the claude-code mapping reproduces today's models exactly; speed.py and gov.py self-tests pass

target.user-input: package.py builds dist/target-id for each target: the command surface in that harness's own format where it has one, the entry file and the shared library, skills and scripts

instruction.user-input: one emitter function per command format in build.py; a target with no command format gets the table and the read-as-files route only

ready.user-input: each release in dist runs doctor on its own paths, with no dependency on the repository

requirement.user-input: the git-native push check from plumbing is on main

target.user-input: library/hooks.md holds one row per guard and target: enforced by a harness hook, by a git hook, by doctor in CI, or asked only

instruction.user-input: hook_wire.py reads the event of each harness that has hooks through one adapter per target; what git can refuse moves to git hooks installed by one script

mandatory.user-input: a target never claims a guard it does not enforce

ready.user-input: each guard's self-test passes on the sample event of every target that claims it

section.name: S07 doubts and headless without the pop-up

target.user-input: conventions section 3 and library/automation.md state how a decision reaches the Regent where no question tool exists, and which headless routes each target runs or refuses, with the reason

instruction.user-input: a blocker ends the reply with one Decision block, two options and a free line; the Judge records a grant only from the Regent's own grant line on such a harness

ready.user-input: headless.py --check resolves every route for every target or names its refusal

section.name: S08 proof on a real pass

target.user-input: one unit of a test project taken through a team pass, or through proceed where the pass is unsupported, on one harness that is not Claude Code, reading generated files only

instruction.user-input: measure time, the guards that fired and the rules the model missed; add health check targets with one line per target; generate the README support matrix from targets.json

ready.user-input: the review packet of that pass reaches the Regent with its measurements

reference.user-input: CLAUDE.md, which already states that the playbooks work the same when read as files
library/registry.json and scripts/build.py, the generator that already emits aliases, tables and README blocks
scripts/package.py, the allowlist build of the installable archive
scripts/hook_wire.py, the one wire contract every hook shares
plumbing commit 85b7e54, the push check as a hook in git's own configuration
library/headless.json and library/automode.json, the two Claude-only profiles

ask.user-input: which harnesses come first, and in which order
are AGENTS.md and the other entry files committed beside CLAUDE.md, or emitted to dist only
does this Order wait for plumbing's 3.4 to reach main, since S06 leans on it
which version carries it: a content change, or a major rule invented
are lead, builder and drafter the tier names

assumption.user-input: regency's rules survive outside Claude Code when they live in scripts and git rather than in the harness; one pass on a hookless harness that breaks a guard unseen knocks this down

target.user-input: two targets or more build from one source with build.py --check up to date and doctor 0 fail
a harness that is not Claude Code finishes a pass on a test project from generated files only
health reports each target's coverage and the README shows the generated support matrix

verify.user-input: no playbook, script or norm exists in two hand-kept copies, on any branch

finally.user-input: the work ends at the Regent's review packet; opening, closing and versioning this Order are the Regent's acts
